title_original: A USB worm’s second life: Retadup spreading CoffeeLoader
description: A new version of CoffeeLoader is spreading through Retadup, an old USB worm whose infrastructure was seized by law enforcement back in 2019.

title_original: SANSAR Linux Cryptomining Malware Uses Modified NVIDIA Library to Hide GPU Activity

title_original: Amazon Uncovers AI Agent Campaign Targeting LiteLLM, Dify, and Other Apps for API Keys
description:
Attackers' AI agents have been hunting for weak spots in internet-exposed AI apps such as LiteLLM, One API, and Dify to steal the AI provider keys stored inside, according to the agents' own records.

The records, which Amazon's threat intelligence team captured with decoy servers, describe stolen keys being used to run the AI models that powered the search for more keys.
